I'm a scientist and healthcare innovation strategist specializing in translating complex diagnostic technologies into market-ready solutions that clinicians and patients embrace. I have an MBA and MS from The Johns Hopkins University and a BS from California State University, Northridge. While completing my graduate studies, I spent 2024-2025 as a [Center for Innovative Leadership Fellow](https://cil.carey.jhu.edu/) focusing on adaptive leadership in healthcare innovation.

Over 10+ years in biotechnology, I've led cross-functional teams in product development through FDA and EU regulatory pathways at companies like BiologyWorks and [Detect](https://www.detect.com). I've launched molecular diagnostic platforms achieving [99.1% accuracy](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220116005038/en/BiologyWorks-know-COVID-19-Clinical-Trial-Matches-99.1-Accuracy-to-RT-PCR-Tests), secured $11M+ in funding for COVID-19 testing solutions, and earned two [patents](https://patents.google.com/?inventor=Ivan+RUEDA) in diagnostic technologies.

My career started as a research scientist developing novel polymer chemistry and sample preparation biochemistry for liquid biopsy analysis. Over time, I transitioned into roles that bridge breakthrough science with real-world healthcare applications in home and point-of-care use cases. My work spans surface chemistry, assay development, data science, and technical product leadership across the diagnostics industry.

I'm passionate about making complex healthcare technology accessible by creating products that integrate seamlessly into clinical workflows and empower collaborative decision-making for patients and providers. My graduate work in healthcare economics, AI applications, and regulatory affairs directly informs my approach to finding the hidden connections between novel science and commercially viable solutions. 

I live in Chicago with my girlfriend and our corgi. In my free time, I play guitar and synthesizers.
